# Translate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Moves native painted content without changing its original flow box.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Translate(options?: TranslateOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`child`](#child): The native subtree to transform.
- [`contentWidth`](#contentwidth): Optional positive child width before transformation, in points.
- [`x`](#x): Signed horizontal paint offset; positive moves right.
- [`y`](#y): Signed vertical paint offset; positive moves down.

### `renderStateful`

Renders this element with state tracking for pagination. Unlike Render(), this method returns a status indicating whether more content needs to be rendered on subsequent pages.

- `ctx`: The render context
- `width`: The available width for this element
